name: Mahjong! at South Regional Library (Durham County)
description: Durham County Library program at South Regional Library for players who already know the game. Library page: "This program is designed for patron who already know how to play mahjong, please remember to bring your tiles and the current National Mahjong League card which can be found on their website." Some sessions are listed as open to all skill levels (per directory); the page read tonight is the experienced-player session.
address: South Regional Library, 4505 S. Alston Ave, Durham, NC
